propDocs.ScrollArea.type: Hover, scroll, auto or always visibility for the custom scrollbars.
propDocs.ScrollArea.scrollHideDelay: Milliseconds before hover or scroll bars hide after activity.
propDocs.ScrollArea.stickToEnd: Starts at the end and follows growing content until the user scrolls away.
propDocs.ScrollAreaViewport.aria-label: Accessible name for the scrollable region.
